summary: Plan and lead successful EdTech implementations with structured change management and adoption metrics. Enrol your team today.
lede: Educational technology implementation and change management covers planning technology rollouts and embedding tools into teaching, learning, and operations. For education professionals leading LMS, virtual classroom, or platform projects, it develops skills in assessing readiness, aligning tools with curriculum and assessment, and creating phased implementation roadmaps. Participants also learn to engage faculty and learners, plan training and support, and define adoption and impact measures using learning analytics and usage data.
audienceIntro: You are responsible for making educational technologies work in real classrooms, training programmes, or digital learning environments, and you need a structured way to guide people through change while proving impact with data.
audience: Change Management Specialist assigned to education
School, College, or Training Center Director
modules: EdTech Strategy, Context, and Change Drivers
Assessing Readiness and Defining EdTech Requirements
Training, Support, and Digital Adoption Enablement
Data, Learning Analytics, and Adoption Metrics
Integrating Emerging Technologies into Change Plans
prerequisites: This intermediate course assumes you already have experience working with educational programmes or learning technologies, and that you are involved in planning or supporting EdTech initiatives. You should understand basic concepts such as learning management systems, digital content, and curriculum or training design. Prior exposure to project management or change initiatives is helpful but not mandatory; all frameworks such as ADKAR and Kotter’s 8-Step Process will be explained with a focus on application rather than theory. No coding or advanced technical configuration is required, but you should be comfortable using standard productivity tools and at least one LMS or virtual learning platform. Participants are encouraged to bring one active or upcoming EdTech project to use as a live case for exercises.
